known_facts_book1: The girl Ruler of the Land of Oz, reigning from the Emerald City.
Was once enchanted into a boy named Tip by the witch Mombi, and freed to become the rightful Princess.
Keeps the Nome King's Magic Belt that Dorothy left with her.
Watches Dorothy daily at four o'clock in an enchanted picture and, on Dorothy's signal, uses the Magic Belt to wish her out of the underground cave into Oz.
Welcomes Dorothy and the Wizard and summons Dorothy's old friends to a reunion.
Makes the Wizard her Official Wizard, offering him a home for life.
Once brought the Sawhorse to life with a magic powder while she was the boy Tip.
Proclaims the Sawhorse 'Prince of Horses' after it wins the race.
Presides as judge at Eureka's trial for eating her pet piglet.
Sends Dorothy home to Kansas and Zeb and Jim home to California with the Magic Belt at the end.

known_relations_book1.the Sawhorse: The wooden horse she brought to life and rides.
known_relations_book1.Eureka: The kitten she puts on trial.

known_facts_book1: A straw man and one of Dorothy's oldest Oz friends, who rushes in to hug her on her arrival.

Recounts having been conquered by General Jinjur and then going to live with the Tin Woodman.
Rides the Sawhorse in the grand procession.
Serves on the jury at Eureka's trial and repeatedly heckles the Woggle-Bug, insisting 'the mind has no eye.'

known_facts_book1: A nickel-plated tin man, Nick Chopper, another old friend who welcomes Dorothy and the Wizard.

Hides a spare piglet in his funnel-shaped hat and produces it to prove Eureka innocent.
Cuts a new leg and ear for the broken Sawhorse with his axe and smashes the vase to free the real piglet.

known_facts_book1: A great tiger with purple stripes who longs to eat fat babies but is held back by his conscience.

known_facts_book1: A wooden horse brought to life by Ozma (as the boy Tip) with a magic powder; the only horse in Oz until Jim arrives.
Has legs shod with gold and carries Ozma's jeweled red-leather saddle.
Meets Jim the cab-horse and marvels to meet at last a 'Real Horse.'
Races Jim and wins easily, being tireless and needing neither food nor breath.
Is kicked and broken by Jim, losing a leg and an ear, then repaired by the Tin Woodman.
Is proclaimed 'Prince of Horses' and Champion by Ozma.
Serves on the jury at Eureka's trial.

known_facts_book1: H. M. Woggle-Bug, T. E. (Highly Magnified, Thoroughly Educated), Dean of the Royal College of Athletic Science.
A pompous, highly magnified insect who reads a book and boasts of being the most intelligent being in the domain.
Leads his college students, in striped sweaters, through the grand procession.
Serves as Public Accuser at Eureka's trial, arguing she should die nine times.
Is repeatedly deflated by the Scarecrow's interruptions about his 'mind's eye.'
